cadence: Curated fixture fragments are re-mirrored from live payloads every new release or every 14 days, whichever comes first (DECISIONS-ModelsDotDevDotnet-payload-tests.md#D011). The enforcement artifact (.github/workflows/fixture-freshness.yml) fails when any lastRemirrored timestamp exceeds maxAgeDays without a new release, and when a release lands after a fragment's last re-mirror.
seededFrom: The fragments' current state: commit 2e86b21 (2026-11-27T19:42:02Z), the last change to PayloadContractTests.cs.

refreshProcedure.precondition: A refresh re-mirrors fragments from live payloads only while the live suite (LivePayloadTests) is green, so a re-mirror never bakes in unresolved drift. Re-mirroring regenerates expected values from live data through the library, pinning current behavior; the live layer owns drift detection.
refreshProcedure.confirmation: A human confirms the green precondition before the refresh lands.
steps: Run the live suite (dotnet test --solution src/ModelsDotDevSharp.slnx) and confirm it is green.
Have a human confirm the green precondition stated above.
Re-mirror each curated fragment in PayloadContractTests.cs from the current live payload through the library, regenerating the expected values from that live data.
Set every entry's lastRemirrored below to the re-mirror time (UTC, RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-11-27T19:42:02Z) in the same change that lands the refreshed fragments.

excludedPins.reason: Reflection pin over the public type surface: it carries no mirrored payload fragment, so no re-mirror timestamp applies to it.
